option_relations.rationale: Bacterial myositis is a broader term that can encompass infections caused by various bacteria, including Fusobacterium necrophorum.
Deep neck space infection is a broader term that can include infections in various spaces of the neck, including those caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum.
Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum is a specific type of infection that matches the details provided in the vignette and the leaf label.
Cervical intramuscular abscess (levator scapulae) due to F. necrophorum is a specific diagnosis that matches the details provided in the vignette and the leaf label.
